01

Connections that drive true transformation.

Real progress happens when the right things come together: expertise and data, insights and human ingenuity, the physical and the digital. At Honeywell Technologies, we make these connections real, turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.

Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.

Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

Autonomy grounded in partnership.

Autonomy isn't a switch we flip. It's a journey taken together. We build on the control systems customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes improvements, and acts only with their approval.

Customer Stories

See our Solutions in Action

Automating Quality Infrastructure with TrackWise Digital

Learn how two companies, Biovac and Inspiration Healthcare Group modernized their quality control work flows with Honeywell's Trackwise Digital.

View Customer Story

Strengthening a legacy refinery's connected future

Motor Oil partnered with Honeywell to design an OT cybersecurity approach for a complex refinery environment, built over five decades.

View Customer Story

Aruba Global Cloud Data Center

Honeywell’s integrated fire and security solution helps ensure the integrity of Italy’s largest data center.

View Customer Story
Insights & News

Innovation, Insights and News

  • Press Release

    Honeywell Technologies Launches Forge Cognition with NVIDIA and Dell Technologies, Advancing Physical AI Across Buildings and Industrial Operations

    Honeywell Technologies introduced Forge Cognition, a self-contained agentic AI and simulation platform for facility operations—developed with technology from NVIDIA and Dell Technologies—across a range of physical environments, such as buildings, campuses and industrial operations.

  • Life Sciences

    Why faster decisions have become a competitive advantage in life sciences manufacturing

    Most life sciences manufacturers have plenty of data but lack context. When QMS, MES and BAS operate independently, decisions slow. See how connected digital threads help.

  • Press Release

    Honeywell Technologies report reveals significant gaps in industry’s OT cybersecurity protection despite rising AI-enabled critical infrastructure threats

    Honeywell Technologies released its 2026 Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity Benchmark Report, revealing a disconnect between how organizations perceive the maturity of their cybersecurity programs and their actual operational readiness across critical infrastructure.

  • OT Cybersecurity

    How connected systems can leave healthcare operators exposed to cyber risk

    Explore healthcare OT cybersecurity risks across connected medical and building systems, and learn why visibility and clear accountability matter.

  • Press Release

    Honeywell Technologies to Help Dangote Build World’s Largest Single-Train Refinery, Accelerating Project Development Schedule by Two Years

    Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE has selected Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) to provide process technologies, licensing, engineering services, proprietary catalysts, equipment and digital solutions for its planned 700,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Kenya.

  • Manufacturing

    What semiconductor labor shortages mean for the future of gas detection

    As semiconductor manufacturers build new mega-fabs across the U.S., workforce shortages are creating new operational challenges. Learn what this means for gas detection and why automation, connectivity, and predictive insights are becoming essential.

Ready to connect?

Like hundreds of other innovators worldwide, join us on the journey  to autonomy.
